It is NOT an aggregator over external workflows: it never queries another workflow's status, check runs or conclusions, and its verdict is derived solely from the results, published outcomes and recomputed applicability evidence of the jobs it directly depends on. It succeeds only when every registered blocker is provably PASS or provably, evidentially NOT_APPLICABLE; skipped is never a pass. The legacy path-filtered workflows remain in place, unchanged, in shadow/reporting state. This state grants NO enforcement or protection authority: no branch protection is enabled, no ruleset is created, and enforcementReady remains false.
